jobs.description:
We engage the most inspired minds to do their best work wherever they work best—powering the freedom to create worldwide.

WP Engine empowers companies and agencies of all sizes to build, power, manage, and optimize their WordPress websites and applications with confidence. Serving 1.5 million customers across 150+ countries, the global technology company provides premium, enterprise-grade solutions, tools, and services, including specialized platforms for WordPress, industry-tailored eCommerce and agency solution suites, and developer-centric tools like Local, Advanced Custom Fields, and more. WP Engine’s innovative technology and industry-leading expertise are why 8% of the web visits a WP Engine-powered site daily. Learn more at wpengine.com.

The Manager of Customer Success is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to achieve high customer retention and superior net revenue retention (NRR). This role requires a strong focus on daily operational excellence, process adherence, and driving measurable improvements in the customer experience across specific segments or territories. An ideal Manager will be a hands-on, highly organized leader who thrives on improving team efficiency, ongoing value driven enablement and achieving measurable business results at a fast pace. The ideal candidate inspires their team and demonstrates a relentless focus on driving customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Coaching

Build & Scale: Build, scale and lead our rapidly growing team, continuing the development of a culture of teamwork, high performance and growth in our Success team.
Performance Management & Development: Lead day-to-day operations, goal setting, career development, performance management, and growth of team members. Directly manage a team of CSMs, conducting regular 1:1s, performance reviews, leveraging Gong and providing direct coaching and feedback on customer engagement, risk mitigation, and renewal strategy.
Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and a leader, helping to develop the skills of the team, so they are able to achieve their metrics and career goals. Supporting and advising new and experienced Customer Success team members in strategies to develop lasting relationships with customers.
Workflow Build & Execution: Ensure the team consistently follows established customer success playbooks, health scoring methodologies, and escalation procedures.

Operational Excellence & Execution

Retention & Growth Targets: Drive the team’s execution of retention programs to meet monthly and quarterly Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets. Accountable for the delivery of the team retention and growth targets and associated Key Performance Indicators.
Risk Management & Escalations: Oversee the proactive identification and mitigation of at-risk accounts, ensuring timely activation of executive engagement and stabilization plans. Lead the response to customer escalations, ensuring related actions are followed through to resolution with the applicable team members.
Data-Driven Decisions: Manage and report on key operational metrics for the team, including Customer Health Scores, Sales Pipeline, Risk Trends, Churn Forecasting, & Success plans. Analyse customer and performance data to make informed decisions about operational and procedural changes.
Tool Utilization: Ensure 100% adherence to CRM and CS platform usage, maintaining data integrity for accurate forecasting and executive reporting.

Customer Advocacy & Feedback Loop

Customer Engagement Strategy: Create customer advocacy and trust by implementing a consultative solution lead approach.
Voice of the Customer (VoC): Systematically collect and synthesize customer feedback and pain points from the team and deliver actionable insights to the Director/VP and Product teams.
Process Improvement & Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with Operations and other managers to identify friction points in the customer journey (e.g., onboarding handoffs, technical support) and propose solutions to improve overall efficiency. Partner with the Director of Customer Success and other global collaborators to further refine the structure, process, systems, and resources to optimally support our customers and team. There is huge scope for creativity and impact in this role.
Renewal Support: Directly assist CSMs with complex renewal negotiations and manage customer escalations that require managerial oversight.

Your Background and Expertise

Experience: 4-6 years' experience leading a customer experience or customer success team. 2+ years of formal experience directly managing and leading a customer-facing team.
Operational & Technical Skills: Demonstrated proficiency with Customer Success platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Catalyst) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) for managing customer health and forecasting. Proficient in Customer Success best practice and methodologies.
Results-Driven & Analytical: Results driven, able to empower their team to focus on strategic goals and critical metric delivery. Ability to analyse and interpret data to optimise performance, increase customer retention and make data-driven decisions.
Leadership & Change Management: Excellent leadership, interpersonal and problem solving/decision making skills. Can lead change, comfortable with ambiguity and able to support the team by building their resilience and managing emotions. Experience working effectively with all levels of management. Experience handling critical customer concerns.
Execution: Ability to lead multiple projects while maintaining strict attention to details. Ability to adapt quickly to new or changing business requirements.
Communication: Ability to communicate effectively in small and large groups.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, Ncontracts leads the industry in integrated risk management and compliance solutions, serving over 5,000 financial institutions nationwide. As an eight-time Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Companies honoree and consistent year-over-year recipient of "Best Places to Work" awards, we offer a thriving, work environment where career growth and life-work balance go hand in hand.

At Ncontracts, you'll join a team of industry experts dedicated to strengthening the financial services sector through innovation and thought leadership. We're seeking creative, collaborative, and self-driven professionals across all areas of our business - from developing cutting-edge solutions to sales, marketing, customer support, and beyond. Join us in our mission to make the financial industry stronger and more resilient, while advancing your career in a supportive, dynamic environment that values your unique skills and perspectives.

Job Description

The Customer Success Operations Manager is responsible for optimizing the systems, processes, workflows, and operational infrastructure that support the Customer Success organization. This role serves as the operational owner for Customer Success business systems, including Salesforce, Churn Zero, Gong, Once Hub, Monday.com, and related platforms, and partners with Customer Success leadership to improve efficiency, consistency, scalability, and the customer experience.

This role supports the customer lifecycle through process design, system optimization, workflow management, documentation, and adoption support. Customer Success leadership retains ownership of customer outcomes, team management, and lifecycle strategy; this role provides the operational structure and system enablement needed to execute those strategies effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Success Systems & Workflow Optimization

Serve as the operational owner for Customer Success business systems, including Salesforce, Churn Zero, Gong, Once Hub, Monday.com, and related platforms.
Partner with Customer Success leadership, Rev Ops, Product, IT, and other stakeholders to improve system functionality, workflows, automation, and user experience.
Gather business requirements, support system configuration, coordinate testing, and assist with implementation of system and process changes.
Evaluate and recommend enhancements to the Customer Success technology stack.

Process Governance & Operational Excellence

Design, document, maintain, and improve Customer Success workflows and operational processes.
Establish process governance standards that support consistency, accountability, and scalability.
Identify operational inefficiencies and partner with stakeholders to implement practical, scalable solutions.
Support change management for process and technology updates, including communication, rollout planning, and adoption support.

Documentation, SOPs & Adoption Support

Create and maintain SOPs, process maps, work instructions, job aids, and reference documentation.
Maintain internal knowledge repositories and ensure operational documentation remains accurate as systems and processes change.
Develop self-service resources that help Customer Success team members understand and adopt tools, workflows, and processes.
Communicate process and system changes clearly to impacted stakeholders.

Customer Lifecycle Operational Support

Partner with Customer Success leaders and managers to support lifecycle programs, including onboarding, adoption, risk management, renewals, and expansion workflows.
Support the implementation and maintenance of customer success programs, plays, and operational processes.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and consistency throughout the customer journey.
Assist with operational readiness for new initiatives that impact Customer Success teams or customer engagement.

Reporting & Operational Insights

Maintain operational dashboards and reports that support process visibility, data quality, system usage, and workflow adherence.
Provide light operational insights to help Customer Success leaders understand adoption, process health, and areas for improvement.
Support data hygiene and process compliance efforts across Customer Success systems.

Job Description

At Regions, the Regulatory Analyst focuses on monitoring, researching, managing, and implementing responses to all regulatory changes at both the federal and state level that affect Regions lines of business. This role is required to draft reporting related to regulatory changes and emerging risks which may be distributed throughout the lines of business or the enterprise. This role also helps develop and update compliance training, and maintains reporting related to the completion of that training.

Primary Responsibilities

Monitors regulatory changes and assesses the changes’ impact to the lines of business
Assembles cross functional teams as needed in order to document the relevant regulatory changes’ impact to Regions line of business
Drafts and distributes line of business or enterprise-wide reporting related to regulatory changes and emerging risks
Prepares, schedules, and administers compliance related presentations and/or conference calls regarding emerging risks and other current regulatory trends
Maintains databases of information related to these regulatory changes
Participates in compliance-related communication strategies, including but not limited to: intranet compliance and regulatory communications, compliance training materials and messaging, and reporting to various committees
Manages and oversees the compliance training program for Regions which may include: developing and updating as necessary applicable compliance MAC courses, maintaining and reporting from the Regulatory and Compliance Risk CERTS process, and developing materials and conducting compliance-related training to the 1st lines of defense

Broad knowledge of banking products, services, and business units.

Job Summary:

HRPP Regulatory Compliance Analyst – HRPP - VICTR

Job Summary

In your pivotal role as a HRPP Regulatory Compliance Analyst, you will ensure continuity and consistency of the research proposal process under occasional guidance. You will also facilitate the protocol process from submission to completion.

This position works normal business hours Monday – Friday and offers the opportunity to work remotely.

About the Department:

The VUMC Human Research Protections Program (HRPP) supports the ethical and responsible conduct of human participants research across the institution. Working in partnership with investigators, study teams, and institutional leadership, the program helps ensure that research involving human participants is conducted in a manner that protects their rights, safety, and well-being. The HRPP oversees and supports all types of human research and promotes compliance with applicable regulations and institutional policy. The HRPP plays a key role in advancing high-quality research that benefits individuals and communities. For more information, please visit Welcome | Human Research Protections Program.

Key Responsibilities

Prepares, analyzes, reviews, and processes new research proposals, amendments, adverse events, and continuing review applications prior to committee meetings.
Analyzes proposal submissions for coordination of biosafety and/or radiation review.
Processes Single IRB submissions.
Applies HRPP policy and federal regulations to proposed research.
Prepares for and facilitates committee meetings by creating and pre-reviewing agenda templates and meeting materials, incorporating regulatory education, and documenting discussions.
Completes and distributes Committee Action Letters and Final Approval Letters.
Manages Continuing Review notification(s) prior to expiration date of protocol.
Performs oversight and verification of database entries.
Routinely initiates and performs quality audits. Assists in conduct of compliance reviews and directed audits. Provides analysis of results and identifies alternatives for resolution of research issues.
Assists with development and revision of existing policies and procedures as well as development of new policies and procedures.
Serves as a preceptor to new staff in the onboarding process.
Prepares and provides training and acts as internal consultant to staff. Provides training for committee members and the research community.
Serves on focused intradepartmental task forces.
Contributes ideas and communicates needs relevant to Strategic Plan development.
Provides customer service to the VUMC research community, assisting with navigation of research regulations, and the IRB submission process.
The responsibilities listed are a general overview of the position and additional duties may be assigned.

Technical Capabilities

REGULATORY COMPLIANCE (INTERMEDIATE)

Demonstrates knowledge of the appropriate rules and regulations and apply them in difficult, stressful and complex situations. Able to interpret and explain rules and regulations that are ambiguous or unclear. Directs others in interpreting rules and regulations on the job and trains others in them.

PROBLEM SOLVING (INTERMEDIATE)

Uses critical thinking and process improvement i.e. coaches and mentors development of problem statement, describes current state, identifies root causes, creates future state, coaches and mentors development of solutions and action plans with a sustainability plan. Applies appropriate tools to address issues.

QUALITY ASSURANCE (INTERMEDIATE)

Job Description

At Regions, the Regulatory Analyst focuses on monitoring, researching, managing, and implementing responses to all regulatory changes at both the federal and state level that affect Regions lines of business. This role is required to draft reporting related to regulatory changes and emerging risks which may be distributed throughout the lines of business or the enterprise. This role also helps develop and update compliance training, and maintains reporting related to the completion of that training.

Primary Responsibilities

Monitors regulatory changes and assesses the changes’ impact to the lines of business
Assembles cross functional teams as needed in order to document the relevant regulatory changes’ impact to Regions line of business
Drafts and distributes line of business or enterprise-wide reporting related to regulatory changes and emerging risks
Prepares, schedules, and administers compliance related presentations and/or conference calls regarding emerging risks and other current regulatory trends
Maintains databases of information related to these regulatory changes
Participates in compliance-related communication strategies, including but not limited to: intranet compliance and regulatory communications, compliance training materials and messaging, and reporting to various committees
Manages and oversees the compliance training program for Regions which may include: developing and updating as necessary applicable compliance MAC courses, maintaining and reporting from the Regulatory and Compliance Risk CERTS process, and developing materials and conducting compliance-related training to the 1st lines of defense
May plan, organize and manage periodic Compliance and Regulatory Risk Management Symposiums

This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Strong verbal, written communication, and organizational skills

Maintain the enterprise regulatory inventory and monitor regulatory developments impacting banking products, services, business activities, and operational processes. Assess regulatory changes to identify potential impacts across business units and functions.
Apply strong knowledge of banking regulations and business operations to analyze regulatory requirements, evaluate business impacts, and identify compliance obligations across lines of business.
Serve as a central liaison among Legal, Enterprise Compliance, Operational Risk, and business stakeholders, coordinating the assessment, communication, and implementation of regulatory changes while relying on Legal for regulatory interpretation.
Facilitate and monitor business impact assessments to determine required changes to policies, procedures, processes, controls, systems, documentation, and training programs.
Review and analyze regulatory alerts, proposed and final rule changes, supervisory guidance, and emerging compliance risks to proactively identify required actions and drive regulatory change initiatives.
Track regulatory implementation activities, project plans, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and outstanding issues to support timely, effective, and sustainable compliance outcomes.
Develop and deliver clear, concise reporting on regulatory developments, implementation progress, key risks, and compliance readiness to leadership and other stakeholders.

Experience in Regulatory Change Management within the banking or financial services industry, including assessing, tracking, and implementing regulatory changes.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into practical business applications.
Broad knowledge of banking products, services, and business units.
Understanding of a wide range of financial services regulations and regulatory frameworks.
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and business stakeholders to drive regulatory compliance initiatives and operational change.
Experience maintaining regulatory inventories, reviewing regulatory alerts, and managing the end-to-end lifecycle of regulatory change implementation.
